product.name: Hilton Honors American Express Aspire Card

benefits.name: Hilton resort credit
benefits.merchant_scope: Purchases made directly with participating Hilton Resorts
benefits.notes: Up to $200 semiannually, for up to $400 a calendar year.

benefits.name: Airline flight credit
benefits.merchant_scope: Flights booked directly with airlines or through amextravel.com
benefits.notes: Up to $50 each quarter, for up to $200 a calendar year.

benefits.name: CLEAR Plus credit
benefits.notes: Tracks the CLEAR Plus membership price; re-verify before relying on the exact figure.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Reward
benefits.estimate_basis: Hilton free night rewards have no points cap, so this is valued at 100,000 Hilton Honors points — a typical standard-room resort award — at 0.4 cents per point per The Points Guy July 2026 valuations. The 100,000-point assumption is a judgement, not an issuer figure; record what the room actually cost to replace it.
benefits.merchant_scope: One standard room night at a participating Hilton property
benefits.notes: Issued on card renewal each year. Additional rewards are earned at $30,000 and $60,000 of calendar-year spend and are tracked separately.

benefits.name: Free Night Reward after $30,000 spend
benefits.estimate_basis: Hilton free night rewards have no points cap, so this is valued at 100,000 Hilton Honors points — a typical standard-room resort award — at 0.4 cents per point per The Points Guy July 2026 valuations. The 100,000-point assumption is a judgement, not an issuer figure; record what the room actually cost to replace it.
benefits.merchant_scope: One standard room night at a participating Hilton property
benefits.notes: Reported as unlockable rather than available (SPEC §4.7) — the app does not track spend.

benefits.name: Free Night Reward after $60,000 spend
benefits.estimate_basis: Hilton free night rewards have no points cap, so this is valued at 100,000 Hilton Honors points — a typical standard-room resort award — at 0.4 cents per point per The Points Guy July 2026 valuations. The 100,000-point assumption is a judgement, not an issuer figure; record what the room actually cost to replace it.
benefits.merchant_scope: One standard room night at a participating Hilton property
benefits.notes: A third reward, earned after $60,000 of calendar-year spend. Reported as unlockable (SPEC §4.7).

benefits.name: Hilton Honors Diamond status
benefits.notes: Complimentary top-tier status while the card is open. No dollar value is tracked.
